content: openpi remote inference: uv run scripts/serve_policy.py --env=LIBERO starts a websocket policy server (port 8000). Client uses openpi_client.WebsocketClientPolicy(host, port); client.infer(obs) where obs = {'observation/image':..., 'observation/wrist_image':..., 'observation/state':..., 'prompt': str}; returns dict with 'actions' key, shape (action_horizon, action_dim).
